events.note: Imported from the legacy dossier: research verdict 'ready', tier T1 (provider-documented), researchedAt 2026-09-20. The verdict and tier are re-expressed as research.state and an evidence class; no product status is carried.

Legacy contract review text for 'github-token', a contract shared by 5 families (verbatim legacy text; the date is the dossier researchedAt, not the authoring date): Re-checked 2026-09-20 (#46): docs.github.com also documents github_pat_ (fine-grained token) as a real, different prefix outside this contract's ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_ set, backing a prefix twin. github.blog/security/application-security/behind-githubs-new-authentication-token-formats confirms the parenthetical checksum claim (CRC32, Base62-encoded, last six characters) but the checksum is not part of this contract's lexical pattern, so a checksum-only mutation still satisfies it and cannot be constructed as a twin here.

Evidence review for issue 55 (2026-10-03, automation, not independently reviewed). The only fixture, cross-provider--prefix-only, spans eight families across four providers and is shared; it was not edited and stays project-policy. Pinned gitleaks (v8.30.1 github.go#L79) and trufflehog (v3.97.4 github/v2/github.go#L37) rules for ghs_ require 36 characters after the prefix, but the fixture also covers other prefixes. The provider docs page notes the legacy ghs_ token as 40 characters and a stateless ghs_APPID_JWT format rolled out from 2026-04-27, so a length-based claim for this family is itself unsettled.

Evidence review for issue 97 (2026-10-03, automation, not independently reviewed; parent epic 92; related to the earlier family review for issue 55, which is neither superseded nor duplicated). Two GitHub changelog entries (2026-04-24, 2026-05-15) and the docs.github.com token-formats note document the staged rollout from 2026-04-27 of the ghs_APPID_JWT stateless form (about 520 characters, two dots, recommended expression ghs_[A-Za-z0-9.-_]{36,}) next to the opaque 40-character form. Contract revision 2 records the current understanding and supersedes revision 1, which is kept for the opaque form. The APPID segment grammar, the stateless length bounds and the rollout end date stay unresolved. Scanner behaviour observed in the 2026-10-03 stress run motivated the research and is not evidence. Related family reviews: 41 to 72.

Combined review of cross-provider--prefix-only proposes tool-corroborated fixture evidence from separately located component statements in nine raw sources reread on 2026-10-03. No provider length asserted; no scanner output used. Proposal awaits non-author review; lifecycle unchanged.
